value.rationale: Theorem 3.18 is the ambient-norm stability theorem in the paper's stability section. The counterexample shows that the failure is not a marginal constant error: for every positive perturbation radius below the theorem's threshold, a valid K-g-fusion frame can be perturbed to a family with no K-lower bound at all. The range repair identifies the exact geometric reason the printed pseudo-inverse argument fails.
